query.text: 请帮我照看孩子，有危险或需要帮助时及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the child, and notify me promptly if there is danger or they need help.

annotation.text_zh: 宝宝正在哭，身边的大人还没有回应，请及时查看并安抚。
annotation.text_en: The baby is crying and the adult nearby has not responded. Please check on and comfort the baby promptly.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
